_success_judgement_note: Anomaly-injection success is NOT decided by a fixed performance-degradation threshold anymore. For each Online Diagnosis Incident record the LLM declares a SuccessCriterion (PERFORMANCE_DEGRADATION / BLOCKING_TIMEOUT / EXECUTION_ERROR) inside anomaly_description.json, and anomaly_eval_rep.py judges success by that declared category. The two thresholds below are DEMOTED to internal engineering knobs that only quantify what counts as a 'significant' slowdown WITHIN the PERFORMANCE_DEGRADATION category; they no longer define success on their own.
